cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you tell your sister she could bring? I taught you to write full names, not leave people guessing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? You used to expect everyone to know who you meant. My list comes after your answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My ex. I sent both of you the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you finally put it in writing. What time did you send it to me? We'll put that beside my invitation's time before I open the list.
